contradicting_version_strings.where: home/andy/ipcam3352_v1.15.10/ (61 SDK header files baked into rootfs)

notes: Flash image layout: 0x0 u-boot legacy uImage 'SPI Flash Image' (standalone loader, U-Boot 1.1.3, contains recovery HTML at 0x1C3E0); 0x50000 uImage 'Linux Kernel Image' lzma (declared 9919699B, actually decompresses to 16473088B) whose payload is directly a cpio (SVR4 no CRC) initramfs rootfs starting with /bin; region beyond ~0x746A00 is all 0xFF padding.

rootfs is an initramfs cpio extracted via binwalk: scratch/15_DCS-5020L/rootfs -> symlink to extract/_dcs5020l_v1.15.12.bin.extracted/_50040.extracted/_3B2000.extracted/cpio-root; 461 regular files + 96 symlinks (busybox).

NO literal '1.15.12'/'115b12'/'20180720' string exists anywhere in rootfs or raw image (grep over all files and ELFs, incl. raw .bin). Firmware version is stored in nvram at runtime and rendered via %%FirmwareVersion();%% template calls (alphapd + etc_ro/web/cgi/*.cgi). Version strings above are build-date/agent metadata only.

Build date 2018-07-03 (etc_ro/release, etc_ro/build unix ts 1530582408, both uImage header timestamps) is consistent; ZIP-name date 20180720 is the packaging date, not the build date. No contradiction with manifest version 1.15.12.
Contradicting v1.15.10 strings are SDK build-path artifacts (build tree named ipcam3352_v1.15.10 reused for the 1.15.12 build); not a runtime version indicator.

CVE-relevant artifacts: bin/alphapd (723920B, GoAhead webs*-based web server, mipsel, stripped) — CVE-2019-10999 target; etc_ro/web/cgi/ contains common.cgi (model/version/build/hw_version fields via templates — CVE-2018-18441 /common/info.cgi analog), wireless.cgi, iwireless.cgi.

Web pages are packed in LZMA language packs etc_ro/web/pack/{eng,cht,twn,frh,grm,itn,kor,sph,dbgulf}.lzma; custom container format (extension table, then name+len+raw content). Decompressed eng pack available at scratch/15_DCS-5020L/webcache/eng.unpack; contains wireless.htm with 34 WEPEncryption occurrences (CVE-2019-10999 sink parameter confirmed present).
Architecture evidence: lib/libcrypto.so.1.0.0, bin/alphapd = ELF 32-bit LSB MIPS (mipsel); kernel modules under lib/modules/2.6.21 (Ralink RT2860v2 / RT3352 SDK, kernel 2.6.21, uClibc 0.9.28).
